summary.intent: Run the GSD gap-closure planning workflow for Phase 68 (ROT-07: rotation UX / durable client state) to create executable plans closing two verification-flagged gaps, then transition into executing those plans.
summary.outcome: Planner produced two new plans (68-11, 68-12) that correctly re-targeted Gap 1's fix location after discovering the VERIFICATION.md-named function was dead code, plan-checker verified both clean with 0 blockers, all coverage gates passed, and execution was launched sequentially (no worktrees) on the phase branch; the transcript ends mid-execution-setup before plan 68-11's executor actually runs.

repo: In packages/sdk/src/client.ts, ensureFolderLoaded is a dead phase-63 stub that throws 'not implemented' (line ~478) — despite being VERIFICATION.md's named gap-1 target, it has zero live callers.

reconcileFolderSequence (client.ts:518) is the actual live pre-mutation resolve chokepoint, invoked before every rename/delete/deleteToBin/move (5 call sites: ~742, 823-824, 985, 1765) — this is where fail-closed rotation gates must be wired, not ensureFolderLoaded.

rotateReadFromNode returns Promise<void> and discards the root rotateOne result (childReadKey/newGeneration/newSequenceNumber); its only production caller is performScopeExitRotation (client.ts:569), making the return type change backward-compatible.
SC#5 doctrine: apps/web must have zero *.spec.ts unit test files — web-side behavior is proven via Playwright e2e specs instead, and plans include a verify command asserting no such files exist.
gsd-tools has a worktree base-check (#683 auto-degrade) that can force sequential non-worktree execution even when worktrees would otherwise be permitted.

code.finding: ensureFolderLoaded: dead phase-63 stub throwing 'not implemented' — unreachable, was incorrectly assumed to be the fail-closed gate location
reconcileFolderSequence: the real live resolve gate, gated via enforceResolved in plan 68-11 to make the fail-closed anti-rollback check reachable
performScopeExitRotation: only caller of rotateReadFromNode; plan 68-12 makes it write the returned RotateReadResult back into folderTree to avoid post-rotation staleness

workflow: Gap-closure mode (--gaps) reads VERIFICATION.md's failed truths, skips research, and appends new numbered plans without touching prior ones — planner is expected to independently re-verify VERIFICATION.md's claimed fix locations against live source rather than trusting them blindly.

When two new plans touch the same shared file (client.ts) but different functions, sequencing them into separate dependent waves (depends_on) avoids parallel-edit collisions without needing worktree isolation.

Conflicting config flags (auto_advance: true plus mode: interactive) should trigger an explicit user confirmation before auto-advancing into execution, especially when the plans touch security-sensitive fail-closed crypto logic.
Post-planning gate chain for this workflow: requirements coverage → decision coverage → STATE.md/ROADMAP annotation → commit check → plan:post gap-analysis, all before presenting final results.

friction: Regenerated API-SURFACE.md hint came back with 0 symbols and had to be omitted from the planner's read list as uninformative noise.

VERIFICATION.md's named fix target for Gap 1 (ensureFolderLoaded) turned out to be dead/stub code, requiring the planner to independently discover and substitute the real chokepoint (reconcileFolderSequence).
First attempt at the post-planning gap-analysis check used the wrong subcommand and had to be re-run.
auto_advance and mode:interactive config settings were contradictory, forcing an extra confirmation checkpoint before launching execution.
open_items: Execution of plans 68-11 and 68-12 was launched but not completed within this session — transcript ends after STATE.md update and executor-skill fetch, before the actual executor agent runs.
Deferred cross-phase finding CannotWriteUntilRefetchError (Phase 65/66, WRITE-03/04) was explicitly excluded from Phase 68 gap-closure scope and remains unaddressed.
